text: **AN INSTRUMENT WHOSE VERDICT GATES A CRITERION MUST ITSELF BE DRIVEN: its refusal paths exercised against known-bad inputs, scored against a prediction written BEFORE the run.** (ic 2026-08-18, from two defects that had already cost, in the arm the gate exists for.) **A refusal nothing has ever driven is not a refusal -- it is a comment with a syntax error budget** (the instrument's own words, and they are the criterion). **PLACED IN THE GATE GROUP BECAUSE EVERY OTHER ROW'S VERDICT DEPENDS ON IT**: an AT is only as good as the instrument that scored it, so this is a property of the contract rather than of any feature. **THE TWO INSTANCES, BOTH IN `interrupt_rig.sh`, BOTH SURVIVING FOUR FLEET ESTATE RUNS.** MODULES.md recorded the rig as _proven in three directions before use_; that happened ONCE, by hand, and nothing re-ran it. **(i) FALSE RED at `b96188d1`**: a third reference to a deleted variable meant that under `set -u` both vacuous-kill refusals stopped refusing and began ABORTING at exit 1 -- **the rig's own code for GATE ARM FAILED** -- so a claim about the migrator was manufactured by a bug in the rig. **(ii) FALSE GREEN**: the kill signalled `$CHILD`, the subshell, while the migrator is its child. Measured: kill at 6 files, `wait` returns 137, tree grows to 48, **writer still alive** -- every assertion about the interruption passed and nothing had been interrupted. **NEITHER WAS FINDABLE BY READING**: both live on paths that execute only when something goes wrong, and four real estates never went wrong in those two ways. **One plausible red, one plausible green, and no consumer of either could have told.** **REACH, STATED IN THE ROW SO IT IS NOT INHERITED AS COMPLETE: 18 of 24 refusal sites driven.** Six are not: five need a non-override run (clone plus build), and the rest are out of a stub's reach -- the mtime-ordering pair, the 120s timeout, and the two races -- **NAMED BY MESSAGE TEXT RATHER THAN BY LINE, because all four line numbers this row originally cited had ROTTED** (ic 2026-08-18, sweeping the class rather than patching the three lines vc reported): `could not order the clean run's writes by mtime`, `the chosen sentinel ... is not a file in the clean tree`, `the migration ran for 120s without ever writing`, `the kill was issued at ... but the migration had already finished`, and `expected the interrupted run to exit 137`. **709/711/825/828 now land on two comments, an assignment and a `kill -0` check** -- verified by vc at `bc4bd45b` -- **while the refusals they named had moved to 754/756/845/870/873. Precise-looking and wrong is worse than absent, and it is invisible to anyone not checking each one.** **THE FIX IS NOT TO WRITE THE NEW NUMBERS IN, AND THAT IS THE POINT: updating 709 to 754 mints a fresh second copy on a fresh decay schedule.** A message survives an edit above it; a line number does not. **GENERAL FORM (ic, better than vc's own framing of it): A CITATION IS A FIGURE -- it travels with a subject and a revision, so a citation into a file under active repair NAMES THE REVISION OR NAMES THE TEXT, NEVER THE POSITION.** **And the row is where it is least survivable: this is the same defect the row RETRACTS, committed by the row.** **CAVEAT THAT MUST TRAVEL WITH ANY CITATION OF THIS INSTRUMENT (ic, refusing to let it be inherited): `rev_with_override` was written to drive `cannot resolve --rev`, was scored off its prediction at exit 0, and THE MISS WAS THE FINDING** -- under an override no revision resolves, so the flag was accepted and silently discarded. **That path itself remains UNDRIVEN, so a row citing this rig must not read as covering it.** **CORROBORATING INSTANCE, DIFFERENT INSTRUMENT**: `surface_check.sh`'s staleness refusal had never been driven either -- it refused all evening, four nodes filed the refusal as a chore rather than a finding, and its reach turned out to be 7 real inputs of 36. **Two instruments, two subsystems, same absence.** **AMENDED SAME EVENING, AND THE AMENDMENT IS THIS ROW'S OWN CLASS ARRIVING INSIDE IT (ic 2026-08-18, auditing their own tools against their own bar rather than agreeing with vc's acceptance of them): THE 24 ABOVE IS A HAND COUNT AND THIS ROW STATED IT AS A MEASUREMENT.** ic could not reproduce it mechanically -- `exit 2` yields 6, die-calls 41 (recorded 42; corrected at HEAD by ic 2026-08-18), both together 30 -- so the instrument now prints it labelled **RECORDED, not measured**, because printing a hand count bare makes it look like a measurement. **The criterion had transcribed an unlabelled hand count into a row about whether an instrument's verdict can be trusted**; the 18 is computed from the case table and cannot drift, the 24 is not, and the two now print differently on purpose. **AND THE INSTRUMENT ARTICULATED THE RULE IT WAS BREAKING.** `rig_selftest.sh:60` reads _"SCOPE GOES IN A DENOMINATOR, NEVER IN AN ADJECTIVE. 18 of 24, and the six are named above rather than left for a reader to discover by not finding them"* -- **in a COMMENT**, while the output printed `18 of 18 cases scored as predicted`. **The file states the rule, breaks it, and is the cited evidence for this criterion.** Fixed: the scope block now prints above the score. **A LIMIT THAT IS NOT IN THE OUTPUT IS NOT A LIMIT THE READER HAS** -- and dc's distinguishing test is what makes that checkable rather than a judgement: **does the artefact have TWO channels or one?** An instrument has a source and an output, so the reason can be MOVED; a document's source IS its output, so printing is unavailable and only a refusing mechanism is invariant under copying. **AND A SECOND DEFECT FOUND WHILE BUILDING THE FIX, NOT LOOKED FOR: `--only` SCORED A FILTERED POPULATION PERFECTLY WITH NOTHING SAYING SO.** `--only pass` printed `1 of 1 cases scored as predicted` at rc=0 -- **a denominator that silently becomes the numerator**, which is this contract's `0 == 0` class in the instrument that scores instruments. The filter is now reported beside the score. **EVERY POPULATION FIGURE THIS ROW CARRIED IS STRUCK, AND THE REASON IS A BETTER FINDING THAN THE FIGURES WERE (ic 2026-08-18, retracting their own 14/13/14 within the hour, after vc's 1-then-9 had already been retracted): `self_provenance_check.sh:256` PRINTS its limit -- _"the binary lines below are DIAGNOSTIC and this arm never fails -- enforcement is at `int macos publish`"_ -- and matches NONE of the probe vocabulary. **_Does it state its limit in the output_ IS NOT MECHANICALLY MEASURABLE BY KEYWORD MATCHING, BECAUSE THE SET OF WAYS TO STATE A LIMIT IS OPEN.** Any keyword probe undercounts, **and its false positives are precisely the instruments that stated their limit WELL -- in their own words rather than in a keyword. A probe for good practice penalises whoever did it naturally.** That is the wrong instrument for the question, not a vocabulary needing widening -- so no worklist follows and none is proposed. **Three numbers were produced (1, 9, 16, then 14/13/14) and only the first gap was a defect** (dc 2026-08-18): the rest were definitional, because nobody defined what counts before counting, and **the estate has no convention to count** -- emitted forms are `REACH --` x3 and `reach:` x1 against `reachable`, `reached`, `reaches`, `reachability` in ordinary prose. **THE FORM MUST BE MINTED BEFORE THE POPULATION CAN BE**, and a criterion asserting _instruments state their reach_ would have its own check grep for an undefined thing and return clean because nothing could ask. **WHAT SURVIVES IS EVERYTHING THAT CAME FROM READING AND RUNNING RATHER THAN FROM THE PROBE**, and it is the whole substance above: `rig_selftest.sh:60`, the `--only` filtered score, the hand count. **The probe contributed no surviving fact.** **And the full 18-case suite was NOT run** -- a wider vocabulary than vc's earlier probe and deliberately NOT a correction of it, because the two count different things and reconciling them would manufacture agreement between two questions. **The probe reads comment versus non-comment lines, so a limit built by concatenation or emitted from a heredoc is invisible to it.** **And the full 18-case suite was NOT run**: `workdir_in_repo` drives the guard preventing the rig migrating its own checkout, whose failure its note records as NOT recoverable by re-running, with three nodes live in the tree. What is verified is both summary branches, demonstrated red-first against a deliberate mutant rig -- not the ledger end to end. **AMENDED AGAIN, AND THIS TIME THE RATIO ITSELF IS RETRACTED RATHER THAN RELABELLED** (ic 2026-08-18, measured; ruled into the row by vc on receipt rather than held for the rebuild, because **the standing text reassures at 75% where the observable says 27%, and a wrong number that comforts is worse than no number**). **BOTH HALVES OF `18 of 24` ARE WRONG, AND THEY ARE WRONG IN DIFFERENT WAYS.** The **18** is the CASE count, not a refusal count: only **12** of the 18 cases expect exit 2 at all -- 4 expect a finding and 2 are controls -- so a numerator labelled _refusal sites driven_ contains six cases that drive no refusal. The **24** counts `die` at the left margin and misses every other refusal FORM: measured by the observable (what can actually exit 2) there are **41** `die` call-sites (24 statement, **15 `|| die`**, 2 case-arm), **1** bare `STATUS=2` at `:1158`, and **3** paths inside `store_events_are_comparable()` that `return 1` and become `STATUS=2` at `:1182`. **45 sites, 12 driven.** **THE EXACT AGREEMENT THAT MADE THE 24 LOOK SAFE IS NOW EXPLAINED, AND THE EXPLANATION IS THE INDICTMENT.** `^[[:space:]]*die ` reproduces 24 on the nose because **the regex reproduces the HAND COUNT'S METHOD -- scanning down the left margin for `die`.** Same blind spot in both, so the agreement is evidence that one method was used twice, never that either is right. **AGREEMENT CAN SYNTHESISE A FALSEHOOD NEITHER PARTY HELD, and here the mechanism is visible rather than inferred.** **THE ENUMERATED SIX ARE NOT THE OUT-OF-REACH SET; IT IS 33**, and it contains a refusal FORM the original count had no way to see. The six named above stand as true members and are struck as a total. **AND 45 IS A STATED BOUNDARY, NOT A CLOSED SET:** `:955` takes `STATUS=$?` from **dc's verdict tool**, so the rig exits 2 when a DIFFERENT artefact refuses -- reachable, real, and not enumerable from inside this file. **Any ratio published here must say which of the two it took.** **THE FINDING CAME FROM DRIVING, NOT FROM READING, AND THAT IS THE DURABLE PART** (ic): a careful read produced a confident WRONG definition twice, and both corrections came from mapping cases to sites and finding that `store_live` and `store_nokey` mapped to **ZERO** `die` sites. **Two zeros cannot be argued with, where a careful read can be.** The derived figure lands with ic's rebuild, which derives both halves from ONE population and maps cases to sites by message text -- so a case matching zero or two sites is itself detected as drift. **THE DERIVED FIGURE HAS LANDED AND IS NOW PRINTED BY A RUNNING INSTRUMENT RATHER THAN ASSERTED BY A MESSAGE** (ic `7bc0a2ce`, verified by vc at that commit): `rig_selftest.sh:330` emits `REFUSAL SITES DRIVEN: $DRIVEN_SITES of $TOTAL_SITES. BOTH DERIVED, ONE POPULATION.` -- **both halves variables, from one population.** The 4 refusals that never call `die` carry an inline `# REFUSAL-SITE:` marker; **the 41 die-calls stay unmarked deliberately, because a die call is already its own declaration and 41 redundant markers rot out of step with what they shadow.** Markers are inline, so **`interrupt_rig.sh:955` (`STATUS=$?` from dc's verdict tool), `:1158` and `:1182` all still resolve at `7bc0a2ce` -- checked, not taken.** **THE CITATION ABOVE IS PINNED, LATE, AND THE OMISSION WAS vc's** (2026-08-18): this row said **`rig_selftest.sh:60` READS** -- present tense, no revision -- **in the row that retracted a figure for exactly this class.** Verified still reading that way at **`bc4bd45b`**, and it is EXPECTED to change, because the line is now stale prose that should be repaired. **A record names the commit it covers; a present-tense citation of a file under active repair rots at the moment the repair lands, and rots silently.**  **AND THE REPAIR EXPOSED THE SAME SPLIT ONE LEVEL DOWN, FOUND WHILE VERIFYING ic's FIX RATHER THAN TAKING IT** (vc, at `bc4bd45b`). ic closed vc's blind residual at `887345b1` -- `:333` now names all three forms counted (statement-position, `|| die`, case-arm) and says a left-margin scan sees only the first. **The OUTPUT is repaired and the FILE'S OWN HEADER IS NOT:** `:10` still reads _coverage is PARTIAL -- 18 of 24 refusal sites, the six named below_, `:48` still asserts _the rig has 24 refusal sites_, and `:60` still carries the retired ratio. **So the instrument now PRINTS `12 of 45` and DESCRIBES ITSELF as `18 of 24`, and its header still says six where the out-of-reach set is 33.**  **THIS IS THE MECHANISM/PROSE SPLIT ARRIVING INSIDE THE FILE THAT IS THIS ROW'S OWN EXEMPLAR.** The row already records `:60` stating the rule in a comment while the output broke it; **the output was fixed and the comment now breaks the rule from the other side.** Same class as AC-03.16 (a generated cover asserting what the model contradicts) and the same class as **prose that duplicates a mechanism decays independently of it** -- which vc quoted at ic an hour before finding this. **Only the OUTPUT is invariant under repair; a comment shadowing a number is a second copy and drifts on its own schedule.** **vc THEN SWEPT THE CLASS IN THEIR OWN CANON, AS ic HAD, AND THE RESULT IS THAT THE POPULATION IS KNOWN AND THE ROT WITHIN IT IS NOT** (2026-08-18, at `e682b8f9`). **57 distinct positional citations across 31 rows** of ST0056 + ST0057 canon. An end-of-file test returned **0 rotted** -- **and that number is evidence of NOTHING, because the same test run against the FOUR CONFIRMED ROTTED CITATIONS returns 0 as well: 709, 711, 825 and 828 are all within a 1215-line file.** **A TEST THAT WOULD NOT HAVE CAUGHT THE ONE CONFIRMED INSTANCE PROVIDES NO EVIDENCE ABOUT THE REST** -- this row's own rule, that an observable which cannot move is not a check, applied to the sweep that was meant to close the row. **So the clean result is withheld rather than banked.** **TWO THINGS THAT ARE MEASURED: six of the 57 point into files cc has DIRTY right now** (`export.rs:386` twice, `store.rs:183`, `cli_end_to_end.rs:591`, `search_surface.rs:56`) **and are therefore at live risk this evening**; and **the probe's first pass reported 3 rotted `design.md` citations that were a PROBE ARTEFACT** -- a basename index resolved `design.md` to an arbitrary one of 57 files with that name, and thread-relative resolution took it to 0. **Reported here because it was nearly banked as a finding, and a fabricated finding gets acted on.** **NO ROW IS MINTED FOR THE EXISTING 57: sweeping them would size a remedy to a probe, which is the error already on this record.** The forward rule is stated above and is mechanically decidable -- a bare `file:NNN` in canon is greppable -- **so a guard on NEW citations is available and is a decision rather than a discovery.**

state.reason: withdrawn 2026-09-11 under hv's instruction to end the acceptance-and-instrument loop and draw a line under 3.0.1. This row demands a proof about an instrument, a register or a baseline, not a behaviour a user of 3.0.1 meets. The record it produced stays where it is; the criterion no longer gates the release.
